initial_scene: Forward-facing view over both robot forearms toward a table. A pink dragon fruit with green tips rests on the pink plate; an empty teal plate is beyond it. The left hand is open above a separate blue plate and the right hand is initially open beside the teal plate.

observed_sequence.action: Both hands remain open; fruit remains on the pink plate.
Right forearm reaches inward toward the fruit; the open hand surrounds the fruit over the pink plate. Left hand stays clear.
Right fingers close around the fruit and secure it; fruit changes orientation while still over the pink plate.
Right hand lifts the fruit clear of the pink plate and carries it toward the teal plate.
Right hand lowers the fruit onto the teal plate and opens its fingers. At the end the fruit rests on the teal plate with the open hand still alongside it.

arm_hand_roles.right: Active hand: reaches to the pink plate, closes fingers around the dragon fruit, lifts and transports it, lowers it onto the teal plate, then opens.
arm_hand_roles.left: Remains open over the blue plate; does not touch the fruit or assist the transfer.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Single-hand manipulation; no hand-to-hand transfer or person interaction.

Neither arm crosses the body centerline during this transfer. Visible articulated fingers and opposing thumb identify the hand rather than a parallel-jaw gripper.
anatomical_side_evidence.limitations: Shoulder attachments and torso are outside this camera view; identification uses the paired forward-facing arm configuration and continuous forearm tracking.
